headline: Weathered Expanse Ignites as Coastal Clashes Shake Western Fronts
war_summary: Combat across the front has shifted dramatically since morning dispatches, marked by a violent resurgence in Weathered Expanse where bitter fighting around Crow's Nest and Frostmarch produced over twenty-seven hundred casualties in two hours. Western sectors have flared into sudden turmoil, with Fishermans Row witnessing rapid casualty spikes and base changes at Fort Ember and Dankana Post, while Farranac Coast remains unstable following fresh clashes that left Transient Valley neutralized. Stonecradle continues to endure heavy attrition, logging nearly three thousand casualties across the last two hours following earlier turmoil over Buckler Sound. High-intensity engagements also press forward in Dead Lands, Linn of Mercy, and Mooring County, where Colonial forces hold an isolated position at The Wind Hills. Meanwhile, several previously active sectors have settled into quiet; fighting has ebbed sharply in Callahan's Passage, and The Gutter has stabilized under total Warden control.
